Not a spa. Not a gym. A place to see your friends.

Most self-care happens alone. We built rooms where you can plunge, sweat and recover side by side, then sit down for tea afterwards.

Every remedy is led by trained practitioners and designed around how long it takes to leave feeling different, not how many appointments we can fit in.

Remedies

Every room is private. Book it alone or bring up to five friends.

    Memberships

    Pick what fits how often you show up. Change plans any month.

    Questions

    Can I bring friends?

    Yes. Every room is private and fits you plus up to five guests, depending on the remedy.

    Do I need experience with ice baths?

    No. Your coach guides your breathing and you can leave the water whenever you like.

    How far ahead can I book?

    Seven days as a drop-in, 14 on Regular and 30 on Inner Circle.

    Can I change or cancel my plan?

    Yes. Switch or cancel any month before your next billing date.

    Built around one idea.

    Health habits stick when they’re shared. Temomi started as a single plunge pool and a group chat, and grew into rooms designed for company.

    We pick every remedy on evidence, train our practitioners in-house, and keep the spaces quiet, warm and unhurried.

    Reserve a remedy

    Tell us what and when. We’ll confirm by email within a few hours.
